test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

On this auspicious Monday, chilled and shudering in spite of astrologer's assurances, he was glad to return to the shelter of canvas awnings on bamboo stakes.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"shudering"** is misspelt. The correct spelling is **"shuddering"**.
 
• The correct word **"shuddering"** means trembling or shaking with fear, cold, or revulsion. (काँपना)
 
 
• **Example:** She was **shuddering **with cold as she waited for the bus.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **auspicious** (शुभ): Conducive to success; favorable.

 
 
• **Example:** They chose an **auspicious **day for their wedding.
 
 
 
• **assurances** (आश्वासन): A positive declaration intended to give confidence.
 
 
• **Example:** She gave her **assurances **that the project would be completed on time.
 
 
 
• **stakes** (दांव): A strong wooden or metal post with a point at one end, driven into the ground to support something.
 
 
• **Example:** He hammered **stakes **into the ground to support the tent.
